Info

Defines collaborator bundle dataclass for ScaraDslService.

class scaralang.core.service.dsl.scara_dsl_bundle.ScaraDslBundle(*, compiler: IScaraDslCompiler, validator: IScaraDslValidator, exporter: IScaraPlanExporter, binary_service: IBinaryService, toolchain_info: IToolchainInfoProvider)[source]¶

Bases: object

Bundle containing collaborating services required by ScaraDslService.

It defines:

attributes:
compiler - Injected IScaraDslCompiler protocol instance.
validator - Injected IScaraDslValidator protocol instance.
exporter - Injected IScaraPlanExporter protocol instance.
binary_service - Injected IBinaryService protocol instance.
toolchain_info - Injected IToolchainInfoProvider protocol instance.
